title: The Island of Liars

steps.prompt: In the haunted village, every resident is either a KNIGHT (always tells the truth) or a KNAVE (always lies). 5 residents speak. Work out who is who. Answer with the first letters of the names of all the KNIGHTS in alphabetical order, with no spaces (for example AC).
clues: Brynn says: "Exactly 1 of the 5 of us is a knight."
Edmund says: "Exactly 2 of the 5 of us are knights."
Gideon says: "Fenella and Brynn are the same kind."

reveal_text: Its jaw opens and a hollow voice says one word: BONE.
